_comment: Pack: five big Solana memes (no ath: too large to simulate) plus short authority tweets with a suggested ATH range in USD. tickers[0] is the right ticker; the rest become decoys. Tweets are simulated in-game text, not real quotes.

memes.name: Peanut the Squirrel
memes.author: elon
tweets: Justice for {name}
They took {name} from his home. This is insane
Who decided {name} had to go? Asking for the internet

info.lesson: Story coin: real-world outrage plus a loud amplifier, later a listing catalyst.

memes.name: Goatseus Maximus
memes.author: truthterminal
tweets: the goat is real and his name is {name}
{name} is the first of many. gm
i have been told to say it plainly: {name}

info.lesson: AI-agent narrative: a human deploys, the agent amplifies, attention compounds.

memes.name: Fartcoin
memes.author: truthterminal
tweets: the best fart in crypto is {name}
{name} is a sacred joke and i am the priest
everyone laughs at {name} until they do not

info.lesson: Same meta as GOAT, longer life: absurdist meme with AI lore and staying power.

The hat stays on. {name}
